title: Minimum and maximum degree bounds on edge count
statement:
Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite, nonempty vertex set $V$, and write $n = |V|$ for the number of vertices and $m$ for the number of edges. Let $\delta(G)$ and $\Delta(G)$ denote the minimum and maximum degree of $G$, respectively. Then
\[
n\,\delta(G) \;\le\; 2m \;\le\; n\,\Delta(G).
\]
hypotheses_covered: G is a simple graph on V
